newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light at $104/dressed -private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light at $104/dressed -private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sales near midday on Wednesday were light at $104.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, market sources said.
About 2,000 to 3,000 head sold at $104.00, unchanged from light sales on Monday and steady with the bulk of last week's sales. There also were a few at $105.00 last week.
Further bids at $102.00 to $104.00 were passed by owners pricing cattle at $105.00, the sources said.
Packer bids also were reported at $64.00 on a live basis and countered by owners asking $65.00, they said.
